work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Brief CVI declares the confessio altar of SS. Peter and Paul in the Vatican crypt privileged for the living and the dead and grants votive Masses and indulgences; LF20289 apo- → LF20298 stolorum across the detached running-title part MDCCCXXXVI. LF20292 (raw heading line-00020292) and page number 137 LF20295; complete 17 July 1836 closing. Own provenance LF20366–20367 excluded. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF20241–20241; the source closing at LF20317–20320 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris. die decima septima iulii millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo sexto, pontificatus Nostri anno sexto. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
